question: out of all donation rupees collected, what fraction came from donors who contributed on more than one occasion - give percent and the number of such donors
gold_sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT "Donor", COUNT(*) AS gifts, SUM("Amount") AS donor_total FROM donations GROUP BY "Donor") SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN gifts > 1 THEN donor_total ELSE 0 END) / SUM(donor_total) AS repeat_share_percent, SUM(CASE WHEN gifts > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_donor_count FROM counts
sql_duckdb: WITH donors_with_multiple_donations AS (SELECT Donor, COUNT(DISTINCT "Receipt No") AS number_of_donations FROM donations GROUP BY Donor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "Receipt No") > 1) SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT d.Amount) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(SUM(d.Amount), 0) * 100 AS percent, COUNT(DISTINCT d.Donor) AS number_of_donors FROM donations AS d JOIN donors_with_multiple_donations AS d2 ON d.Donor = d2.Donor

CURRENT QUESTION:
out of all donation rupees collected, what fraction came from donors who contributed on more than one occasion - give percent and the number of such donors
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH donors_with_multiple_donations AS (
  SELECT
    Donor,
    COUNT(DISTINCT "Receipt No") AS number_of_donations
  FROM donations
  GROUP BY
    Donor
  HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT "Receipt No") > 1
)
SELECT
  CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT d.Amount) AS DOUBLE) / SUM(d.Amount) * 100 AS percent,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.Donor) AS number_of_donors
FROM donations AS d
JOIN donors_with_multiple_donations AS d2
  ON d.Donor = d2.Donor;
```
